text:
ellie (Design): Hey folks — quick design check for the trace minimap + stack pane. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/protos/trace_minimap_v3.png. I'm worried the minimap labels read as decorative and aren't discoverable for keyboard users.

matt (Product): Nice — overall feels lighter. What are the exact a11y concerns?

arjun (Eng-runtime): Main issue is the minimap is implemented as pure SVG with no focusable nodes. Keyboard users can't tab into spans to see correlation IDs.

sam (Accessibility): Exactly. We should add focusable hotspots with aria-labels like `aria-label="Span 4 of 12: db.query - correlation id 0xabc123"` and role="button". Plus visible focus ring.

claire (Design): I like adding hotspots. Visually I'm worried about noise — don't want focus rings on every tiny rect by default. Maybe show focus ring only when keyboard navigation detected?

arjun (Eng-runtime): We can toggle a11y styles with a `prefers-reduced-motion` or a keyboard-mode CSS class set by JS. Works fine.

nora (Eng-SRE): Also: when you hover a minimap rect we currently show a tooltip with trace time and span name. For export (CSV/JSON) flows, the tooltip content should match export column names. Right now the tooltip says "duration ms" but export uses "latency_ms" which causes confusion.

ellie (Design): Good catch — canonicalize copy. Proposal: tooltips use human copy ("Duration"), export headers use snake_case keys, and we provide a small mapping in the export modal showing both. Thoughts?

matt (Product): Mapping is smart. Many users open export into spreadsheets and get confused by mismatched labels. Keep the UI copy friendly.

sam (Accessibility): One more: the "Copy correlation ID" affordance in the stack pane is an icon-only button with title text only on hover. That doesn't work for screen reader users. Make it a visible text button or include an offscreen label for screen readers. E.g., `<button aria-label="Copy correlation id 0xabc123">` and ensure role and keyboard focus.

claire (Design): Agree — maybe show "Copy ID" text on hover and keep icon-only in the collapsed compact mode. Also update the contrast token for the icon: current color is #616161 which is <4.5:1 on white. Suggest #3b3b3b.

arjun (Eng-runtime): Will update the component to support `labelVariant="visible|sr-only|compact"` and pass color tokens.

nora (Eng-SRE): Quick perf note: adding lots of focusable hotspots could impact render at high trace density. Please keep the DOM footprint small — reuse a single focusable container and move highlighted region on arrow keys rather than creating 200 buttons.

ellie (Design): Good call — prefer single focus region + arrow key traversal for performance. We'll wire microcopy to announce "Span X of Y: <name>, duration <ms>" via live region when focus changes.

arjun (Eng-runtime): Sounds good. Also thinking about the export button placement — current toolbar has Export + Share + Download snapshot. People asked for Export closer to the top-right of the trace pane. Can move it into the pane header and turn it into a dropdown (CSV / JSON / HAR).

matt (Product): Make sure export dropdown remembers last-used format per workspace. Little UX win.

sam (Accessibility): Dropdowns must be keyboard-navigable and trap focus properly. Also ensure the HAR option includes correlation_id and span_id fields documented.

ellie (Design): Copy tweaks: replace "Download snapshot" with "Save snapshot (PNG)" to be explicit; change export option labels to "Export events (CSV)" and "Export structured trace (JSON)". 

claire (Design): Tiny nit — the trace header currently shows correlation id as `corr: 0xabc123`. Can we show the full label "Correlation ID: 0xabc123" on mobile/compact hover? It's truncated and that hurts copy discoverability.

arjun (Eng-runtime): We can change render to `Correlation ID:` for widths < 600px? Probably the opposite — make abbreviated when small. But we can add a tooltip that shows full label on overflow, and ensure `aria-expanded` state on the collapsed label for screen readers.

nora (Eng-SRE): Also add a quick link action next to the ID to "Open all spans with this correlation id" — this is useful for SRE workflows.

ellie (Design): We'll mock that as a secondary text button in the header. I'll update the prototype and push a new Figma link.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: infra/trace-ui/a11y-hotspots v1.3 -> staging at 2026-03-23T16:10:00Z :rocket:

arjun (Eng-runtime): I'll pick up the component changes after the staging deploy. Planning to implement single-focus hotspot + live-region announcement + export header mapping.

matt (Product): Nice. Can we get a quick checklist so design + a11y can sign off before prod rollout?

ellie (Design): Yep — I'll post a short PR checklist: 1) keyboard traversal + live-region messages, 2) export header mapping modal, 3) visible focus styles only when keyboard nav, 4) copy updates (exact strings), 5) contrast tokens updated. Will tag @sam and @nora for sign-off.
